subject: Web Development
title: TLS and HTTPS
description: A short lesson to help you apply TLS and HTTPS.

hook.text: Without encryption, anyone on the same network could read your web traffic.

buildup.text: TLS encrypts the connection between your browser and the server before any data flows.

discovery.text: A TLS handshake exchanges keys in milliseconds, creating a private tunnel.

twist.text: Let's Encrypt made TLS certificates free in 2015, removing the last excuse for HTTP.

climax.text: Today over 95% of web traffic is encrypted. The padlock icon is the new normal.

punchline.text: Free encryption secured the entire web.

quiz.question: What did Let's Encrypt do for the web?
